remarks:
Welcome to 3777 Captains Way, North Tonawanda!

This 12-year-young, 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect combination of modern living, entertaining space, and a backyard retreat unlike any other! The first floor features an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area with a bright and inviting morning room, a wood-burning fireplace, and a convenient half bath. The first floor was freshly painted in September 2026, giving the space a fresh, updated feel.

The attached 2-car garage is a standout feature, complete with gas heating, an upgraded garage door opener (Fall 2025), and a golf simulator that is negotiable with the sale.

Upstairs, you’ll find four bedrooms, a second-floor laundry room, a full bathroom, and a private primary suite with its own full bathroom. The partially finished basement, completed in November 2020, provides additional living space along with a separate storage room featuring shelving and the home’s mechanicals. Enjoy peace of mind with a brand-new hot water tank (September 2026) and a brand-new sump pump with backup system (January 2026).

Step outside from the morning room onto your covered patio, featuring a home addition completed in November 2020 that provides extra shade and the perfect space for entertaining. A Bluetooth speaker system adds to the outdoor atmosphere, while the hot tub offers the perfect place to relax overlooking the huge backyard with no rear neighbors.

The property also features an inground sprinkler system servicing both the front and backyard, a storage shed, and a driveway that was freshly sealed in Summer 2026.

The true showstopper is your very own putting green! Whether you’re perfecting your golf game or enjoying some friendly competition, this unique backyard feature adds a fun touch to everyday living.

Conveniently located just off Shawnee Road and Niagara Falls Boulevard, you’re only minutes from the Wurlitzer Building, with plenty of nearby dining, shopping, and amenities.

Don’t miss your chance to own a home that brings comfort, convenience, and a little fun to everyday living!
